newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu opponents burn Zaire flag in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu opponents burn Zaire flag in Paris.

text.p: Opponents of ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko clambered onto the balcony of Zaire's Paris embassy on Saturday and burnt a Zairean flag in a show of support for rebels sweeping across the east of the country.
"They used ladders to climb up the outside of the building onto the balcony," an embassy official said. "Nobody broke in." Several dozen opponents protested at the embassy in central Paris.
On Friday, Mobutu flew home from the French Riviera, where he had been convalescing from prostate cancer surgery last year, hoping to bolster resistance to rebels advancing across eastern Zaire.
